long_biography.plain_text:
Özen worked in textile manufacturing before becoming founding chairman of Ozon Triko in 2001. Its production knowledge provided the platform for DeFacto, whose first store opened in Istanbul in 2005. Rather than run retail alone, he chaired the board while experienced managers developed the brand.

DeFacto concentrated on accessible fashion and expanded beyond menswear into broad family clothing collections. Its managers used market research to shape the offer, built an international store network and added e-commerce alongside wholesale and franchise channels. Özen remains chairman, directing strategy while chief executive İhsan Ateş leads operations.
